messages:
jordan: Heads-up — thinking about adding structured error fields for routing + fallback metadata so Console can filter incidents better. e.g. include `routed_from`, `routed_to`, `fallback_used`, `quota_bucket` in the error payload. Thoughts on API contract impact?
maya: I like it. Do we plan to bake those into the HTTP body or as headers? headers are easier for proxies but bodies are better for rich context.
sam: Headers are constrained (size) and messy for nested info. body JSON is the clean move. We should keep a stable top-level `error.code` and `error.message` + `error.meta` freeform map for compatibility.
jordan: Agree on `error.meta`. Want `error.retriable` boolean too. Also want a small canonical enum for `fallback_used`: none|model_variant|region|degraded_path so Console can group.
liam: +1. Also need to consider bandwidth: many small requests will add telemetry. Maybe only include full `error.meta` when `X-Debug: true`? Otherwise return a reduced set.
maya: That risks Console not having enough data for postmortem. Alternative: emit full telemetry as events to our logging pipeline, but keep response payload small. Console can query traces/telemetry for details.
jordan: Good separation. Keep client-facing payload minimal: `error.code`, `error.message`, `error.hint?`, `error.meta_summary` (short tags). Full detail emitted as internal telemetry event with fields: `request_id`, `routed_from`, `routed_to`, `fallback_used`, `queue_delay_ms`, `model_variant`, `quota_bucket`.
infra-bot: deploy: canary rollout of error-meta-pipeline v1 scheduled for 2026-06-12 02:00 UTC.
kelly: UX note — in Console's issues list we should surface `meta_summary` as pill tags (e.g., "fallback:model_variant", "quota:high") and let users click through to telemetry. Also add a "why this fell back" short explanation on the request detail panel.
sam: Implementation notes: runtime will need to attach routing tags at the router layer so all downstream services inherit them. Also need schema versioning: `error.schema_version` so old SDKs can parse.
liam: For HTTP statuses: keep current mapping (5xx server, 4xx client). Use a new 429 subcode pattern? I'd prefer not to invent new statuses — use header `Retry-After` + `error.code` like `quota_exceeded:rate_limit` for client guidance.
jordan: Sounds good. Action items: 1) propose `error` JSON schema (v1) 2) telemetry event spec for internal pipeline 3) Console changes (meta pill + detail text) 4) canary rollout plan and SDK doc updates. I'll sketch the schema now:
jordan: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "quota_exceeded",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded for route",
    "retriable": false,
    "meta_summary": ["quota:high","fallback:none"],
    "schema_version": "1"
  }
}
```
maya: Looks clean. Make sure `code` is namespaced if needed: e.g. `quota/exceeded` to avoid collisions with model-level codes.
kelly: UX concern: messages shown in-app must be short and non-technical. Console should map `error.code` -> friendly text via i18n table. Keep `error.message` internal.
sam: Agree. Also add telemetry tag `rollout_id` so we can correlate regressions to canary groups.
jordan: Great point. I'll open an RFC with these details and tag infra/runtime/console. Will include example migration plan for SDKs.
kelly: Thanks — can we also include a small FAQ blurb for customers explaining why some errors are minimal? helps support.
jordan: Yep. Thanks all. Closing and will prod PRs tomorrow. :thumbsup:
